cases.sentence: Я не желаю быть судьей в ___.
cases.explain: «подобных делах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

cases.sentence: — Я вернусь, если на то будет ___, — пообещал Павел на прощание и отплыл из Эфеса.
cases.explain: «Божья воля» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

cases.sentence: Аполлос убедительно опровергал иудеев в ___, доказывая Писаниями, что Христос — это и есть Иисус.
cases.explain: «открытых диспутах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
